description: This file manages caching and retrieval of model endpoint data, specifically for the 'openrouter' provider, using in-memory cache and file system cache. It includes functions to get, read, write, and flush model endpoint data, integrating with external modules for storage, file handling, and model data.

methods.name: writeModelEndpoints
methods.description: Asynchronously writes model endpoint data to a JSON file in the cache directory.

methods.name: readModelEndpoints
methods.description: Asynchronously reads model endpoint data from a JSON file in the cache directory.
